<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const contentContainer = document.querySelector('.brxe-post-content');
    if (!contentContainer) return;

    const headings = contentContainer.querySelectorAll('h2, h3, h4, h5, h6');
    if (!headings.length) return;

    const toc = document.querySelector('.table-of-content-1 ol');
    if (!toc) return;

    toc.innerHTML = ''; // Clear existing ToC entries

    let lastLevel = 2;
    let currentOl = toc;
    let olStack = [toc];

    headings.forEach(heading => {
        const level = parseInt(heading.tagName.substring(1));
        const sanitizedId = heading.textContent.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '');
        heading.id = sanitizedId;

        if (level === 2) {
            // Reset to the top level for h2 headings
            currentOl = toc;
            olStack = [toc];
        } else if (level > lastLevel) {
            // Create a new nested list for lower level headings
            const newOl = document.createElement('ol');
            newOl.className = 'brxe-block table-of-content-1-ol';
            olStack[olStack.length - 1].lastElementChild.appendChild(newOl);
            olStack.push(newOl);
            currentOl = newOl;
        } else if (level < lastLevel && level !== 2) {
            // Adjust the stack for heading levels that are not h2
            while (olStack.length > 1 && level <= parseInt(olStack[olStack.length - 2].tagName.substring(1))) {
                olStack.pop();
            }
            currentOl = olStack[olStack.length - 1];
        }

        const li = document.createElement('li');
        li.className = 'brxe-block table-of-content-1-li';
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.className = 'brxe-text-link table-of-content-1-li__link';
        a.href = '#' + sanitizedId;
        a.textContent = heading.textContent;
        li.appendChild(a);
        currentOl.appendChild(li);

        lastLevel = level;
    });
});
</script>
